title: Save Me, O My God

questions.question: O Lord, how many are my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 3:1 (ESV): "O Lord, how many are my foes! Many are rising against me;"

questions.question: Many are saying of my soul, "There is no what for him in God"?
questions.explanation: Psalm 3:2 (ESV): "many are saying of my soul, 'There is no salvation for him in God.'"

questions.question: But you, O Lord, are a shield about me, my glory, and the lifter of my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 3:3 (ESV): "But you, O Lord, are a shield about me, my glory, and the lifter of my head."

questions.question: I lay down and slept; I woke again, for the Lord did what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 3:5 (ESV): "I lay down and slept; I woke again, for the Lord sustained me."

questions.question: Salvation belongs to whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 3:8 (ESV): "Salvation belongs to the Lord; your blessing be on your people!"

questions.question: I cried aloud to the Lord, and he answered me from his holy what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 3:4 (ESV): "I cried aloud to the Lord, and he answered me from his holy hill."

questions.question: I will not be afraid of many thousands of people who have set themselves against me where?
questions.explanation: Psalm 3:6 (ESV): "I will not be afraid of many thousands of people who have set themselves against me all around."

questions.question: Arise, O Lord! Save me, O my God! For you strike all my enemies on the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 3:7 (ESV): "For you strike all my enemies on the cheek; you break the teeth of the wicked."

questions.question: You break the teeth of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 3:7 (ESV): "...you break the teeth of the wicked."

questions.question: Your blessing be on your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 3:8 (ESV): "...your blessing be on your people!"

questions.question: What happens when David cries aloud to the Lord?
questions.explanation: Psalm 3:4 (ESV): "...and he answered me from his holy hill."

questions.question: This Psalm is written when David fled from whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 3 Title: "A Psalm of David, when he fled from Absalom his son."

questions.question: What word is used at the end of verses 2, 4, and 8?
questions.explanation: The word "Selah" appears at the end of these verses in the text.

questions.question: Who sustained David when he slept?

key_verse_text: But you, O Lord, are a shield about me, my glory, and the lifter of my head.
